task.description:
Step 3 — Implement the fix for ISS-0716 / GH-814 per the validated design at src/design/wf03-gh814-ddl04-backfill-bookkeeping-fix.md.

Branch: feature/WF03-GH814-20260817

Implementation steps:
1. In src/platform/backfill.zig:
   a. Add `batch_size: u32` as a new parameter to `recordBatchProgress`; bind it in the INSERT as $9 (replacing the 5000 literal); ON CONFLICT UPDATE should also persist `backfill_batch_size = EXCLUDED.backfill_batch_size`.
   b. Add a `recordTerminalStatus` function (or inline call) that does `UPDATE plat_migration_state SET status=$4 WHERE migration_id=$1 AND tenant_schema=$2 AND phase=$3` — called after the while loop exits, passing 'applied' (success) or 'failed' (stall).
   c. Update all call sites of recordBatchProgress to pass the current batch_size.
2. Update tests/integration/ddl04_backfill_loop_test.zig TC-DDL-04-AC6:
   a. Extend the SELECT query to include backfill_batch_size.
   b. Replace the status='running' assertion with status='applied' (success path) / status='failed' (stall path).
   c. Remove the NOTE comment documenting the divergence.
3. Run zig build (exit 0).
4. Run zig build test-integration-ddl04 (or equivalent) — all tests must pass.
5. Commit: fix(GH-814): persist adaptive batch_size and terminal status in plat_migration_state
6. Push to feature/WF03-GH814-20260817.

result.summary: Implemented GH-814 fix: added batch_size param to recordBatchProgress ($9 binding, replaces literal 5000, ON CONFLICT no longer resets status); added recordTerminalStatus function (UPDATE plat_migration_state SET status=$4, backfill_batch_size=$5); added terminal-status call in runBackfill after loop exit (applied/failed per stall flag); updated TC-DDL-04-AC6 to SELECT backfill_batch_size, assert status='applied', assert backfill_batch_size='5000', removed NOTE comment. zig build exit 0; 6/6 DDL-04 backfill loop integration tests passed.
